Right panel includes expression sheets, close-up detail panels showing headpiece, hair ornaments, bow, sleeves, embroidery, lantern, shoes and accessories. Include accessory breakdown featuring the moon lantern, tassels, charms, ribbons and magical ornaments. Include companion turnaround showing the rabbit from front, side and back. Add a refined color palette featuring blush pink, lavender, plum, ivory, champagne gold and warm cream.

Use the provided image as the sole design reference for the adult rabbit-eared witch, her white rabbit companion, and the moon-rabbit lantern. Keep their faces, proportions, costumes, colors, accessories, and silhouettes consistent in every shot.

Style: premium anime rendering, magical-girl combat, dreamlike fantasy game CG, cinematic 3D environments, volumetric moonlight, realistic cloth and hair physics, elegant particles, soft lavender, moon-white, pale pink, deep violet, muted gold, and icy blue. Fast and intense action without excessive cuts, camera shake, overexposure, or effects obscuring the characters.

0–2.5s: Begin immediately in battle. Under a huge silver moon, a 30-meter black nightmare beast crashes four shadow tentacles onto a floating crystal island. The witch leaps away carrying the rabbit, places it inside a protective moonlight bubble, deflects another tentacle with a translucent crescent shield, backflips, and lands on a floating step. Reveal the beast’s panther-like body, two horns, magenta eyes, four legs, four back tentacles, long tail, and glowing violet-black chest core.

2.5–5s: The beast fires a sweeping wave of dark energy. In a fast side-tracking shot, the witch sprints across three temporary crescent platforms and vaults over the attack. She raises her circular moon-rabbit lantern; its rabbit emblem glows and its gold frame rotates. Three layered lunar magic circles unfold, releasing thin starlight beams that dissolve the dark wave.

5–8s: Four tentacles chase her through a glowing lavender crystal forest. She dodges between trees, runs up a tilted trunk, then front-flips above crossing tentacles. She lands on moonlight platforms over a mirror-like floating lake. The beast strikes the water, creating a violet-blue wall and shadow vortex. She rides the water wall upward while the camera looks through the lake toward her silhouette and the moon.

8–11s: The beast forms a black ring that consumes the stars and fractures the dream world. The witch raises the lantern overhead as moonlight connects it to the full moon. The rabbit’s collar gem shines; it becomes a slightly translucent moon-rabbit spirit with the same rabbit body and face, platinum rim light, and two ribbon-like light trails. It circles the witch as a vast twelve-phase lunar magic circle opens beneath her.

11–13.5s: The beast launches a massive violet-black beam. The witch charges forward behind a three-layer crescent shield. The moon-rabbit spirit repairs the cracking shield with its light trail, then becomes a clearly rabbit-shaped platinum streak. The lantern focuses a pale pink and gold purification beam. Both attacks merge into a giant white-gold crescent and strike the beast’s chest core. No explosion—only a vast, silent lunar ripple.

13.5–15s: The core turns soft lavender. The beast peacefully dissolves into black petals, violet stardust, and gentle night mist. The islands, crystal bridges, forest, lake, flowers, stars, and full moon restore themselves. The witch lands beside the lake; the lantern returns to its original round form, and the spirit becomes the same physical white rabbit again. End with a smooth epic pullback and hold the restored dream world for the final 0.6 seconds.

The witch is an adult woman with long silver-white hair fading slightly pink, two thick braids, white rabbit ears, dark violet-and-gold moon ornaments, amber-red eyes, a layered white and pale-pink shrine-maiden dress, oversized dark violet sleeves with muted gold lunar embroidery, and deep violet platform shoes. She never changes costume and never uses a wand or weapon.

No dialogue, narration, lyrics, text, subtitles, UI, watermark, or logo. No child proportions, costume changes, wings, tails, extra lanterns, anatomical deformation, inconsistent monster anatomy, blood, injury, impalement, horror gore, cyberpunk elements, modern cities, cheap neon colors, violent camera shake, heavy blur, flicker, or full-screen effects.

This AI workflow is wild

I used GPT Image 2 to create a character sheet, then animated it with Seedance 2.0 in just a few minutes

Prompt in thread 🧵

1️⃣character sheet:

Ultra-detailed 16:9 fantasy character design sheet, official AAA fantasy RPG character bible, clean editorial layout, elegant ivory background with minimal luxury UI. Character name "NEFRA", title "Desert Oracle", subtitle "A wandering oracle from the endless dunes, she reads the flow of fate and guides lost souls."

Left panel features a full-body hero illustration of a petite desert priestess with warm bronze skin, short platinum-white bob hair, golden amber eyes and a calm mysterious expression. She wears an elegant white-and-gold desert ceremonial outfit featuring flowing silk veils, asymmetrical layered skirts, ornate golden jewelry, engraved belts, arm cuffs, anklets and delicate embroidered patterns. She stands barefoot while holding an ornate crescent-shaped oracle staff decorated with gold filigree, gemstones and hanging charms. The overall silhouette feels graceful, sacred and lightweight.

Center panel includes professional turnaround views (Front, Side, Back), perfectly consistent anatomy, hairstyle, costume and proportions, shown in neutral pose.

Right panel includes a large head close-up, multiple facial expressions, close-up panels of the oracle staff, fabric embroidery, jewelry, belts, arm ornaments, anklets and embroidered pattern details. Include accessory panels featuring necklace, headpiece, earrings, bracelets and waist ornaments. Add a refined color palette featuring ivory, sand beige, warm gold, bronze, cream, light brown, charcoal and metallic gold.

Style: official fantasy RPG character sheet, ancient Egyptian × Arabian fantasy aesthetic, premium game artbook illustration, Genshin Impact / Granblue Fantasy / Riot Forge quality, anime realism, elegant fantasy costume design, intricate gold ornaments, production-ready concept art, masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, 8K, clean composition, no watermark, no logo, no extra limbs, no deformed anatomy.

2️⃣video prompt:

An endless golden sea of sand at dusk. Rolling dunes stretch to the horizon, wind smoking streams of sand off their crests, the sky stained ochre by a colossal sandstorm devouring the distance. A desert oracle (character reference "NEFRA": dark skin, white bobbed hair with straight bangs and a plume of white feather-like strands tied atop her head, golden eyes, black-and-gold headband with tasseled gold earrings, white bandeau top with a translucent white shawl, black-and-white layered slit skirt hung with gold plates and tassels, gold armlets, collar, and anklets, barefoot, carrying a golden staff crowned by a crescent cradling a glowing orb) walks alone into the wind, shawl and hair whipping, the staff's orb shedding a faint glow that lights each step.

[0-3s] Opening extreme wide shot: her tiny figure trudging toward the distant storm wall across the vast sands, ankle-deep in flowing grains, her footprints erased by the wind behind her. Camera pushes in slowly and sinks to a low angle — she plants the staff to brace herself, eyes narrowed toward the storm's heart. Suddenly a deep rumble rolls up from below: the dune beneath her begins to slide, vast ripples spreading across the sand as if something immense swims beneath. Her golden eyes reflect the surging waves.

[3-6s] The beast emerges: the sea of sand ahead erupts — a colossal desert leviathan of flowing dust rises from the ground: a body sprawling like a mountain range, part ancient whale, part great serpent, formed of sand that endlessly cascades, collapses, and regathers; two points of dark gold burn in its eye sockets, fragments of swallowed ancient stone carvings embedded in its hide. It rears, hurling a sand wave tens of meters high crashing toward her like a tsunami. She sweeps her staff in an arc — a ring of golden runes blooms before her, meeting the wave head-on: the sand detonates against the rune barrier and splits, thundering past on both sides. Low-angle shot from behind her selling the titan's rise, cutting to a close-up behind the barrier as the wave hits.

[6-9s] Guerrilla across the dunes: the beast dives and swims at speed beneath the sand, dunes collapsing in swaths above its passage; it bursts out around her again and again in ambush, spinning up columns of sandstorm that shred the terrain. She sprints between collapsing and rising dunes, glissades down slopes, leaps a splitting sand chasm, shawl snapping in the storm. Mid-run she flourishes the staff repeatedly: golden runes array in the air, gathering sand into huge gilded blades that streak against the storm and burst across the beast's flank in ripples of gold. High-speed tracking on her route, intercut with low-angle impacts of the beast's breaching ambushes.

[9-12s] The hidden power wakes: the battle's energy stirs what sleeps below — she crests a high dune and raises the staff overhead, its orb erupting in a pillar of light: the whole desert shudders as ancient ruins rise slowly from beneath the sands — colossal columns, broken temples, rune-carved obelisks breaking the surface one after another, their golden glyphs igniting in sequence, answering her staff's light. Golden energy spreads along the rune network into glowing veins across the sand, the airborne dust dyed into drifting golden haze. The beast thrashes and roars at the center of the web of light, its storm coiling violently against the gold. Spiral orbiting crane shot revealing the ruins ascending and the luminous network unfurling across the entire desert.

[12-15s] Mastering the storm: standing at the dune's crest, she grips the staff two-handed and sweeps it in a full turn — every lit rune across the ruins streams into the orb and fires as a heaven-splitting beam of gold into the storm's heart. Bathed in the light, the leviathan's raging form is slowly tamed: the sandstorm decelerates, turning, coiling into a vast quiet ring of golden sand around the pillar of light; the beast's dark-gold eyes close in the radiance as its immense body sinks gently back into the sea of sand. The wind dies; sand settles; sunset breaks through the clearing dust across ruins and dunes. She lowers the staff at the summit, her shawl drifting still — freeze frame on the epic composition of her small figure against the golden ruin-strewn desert.

Style: epic fantasy RPG × desert mythology × AAA game-CG, with the desolate grandeur of Dune and the fantasy staging of Final Fantasy / Genshin. Character design strictly consistent throughout: white feathered bob, dark skin, golden eyes, white-gold garments, golden crescent staff. Signature VFX language: flowing-sand physics (the beast's forming and collapsing body, sand waves, sinkholes, storm columns) interwoven with golden rune magic (barriers, sand blades, light network, beam) — granular physicality against magical radiance. Extreme scale contrast of tiny figure versus colossal creature throughout. Narrative arc: lone journey → beast's emergence → evasive skirmish → ruins awakening → storm mastered; the ending is command, not destruction, true to her oracle nature. Palette: golden sands, warm gold runes, ochre storm dust, white-gold character, sunset orange. Lighting: low warm dusk light, self-illuminated staff and runes, volumetric beam through sand haze. Camera: wide-shot slow push, behind-the-shoulder titan reveal, high-speed skirmish tracking, spiral crane over rising ruins, final epic freeze — no hard cuts. 4K, cinematic lighting, HDR, rich sand-particle detail.

entries.text: This prompt lets you introduce 6 people using transitions with eye match cuts and such. (For three or four people, you can do the same by referencing the same images used for Character 1 or 2 in the spots for Character 5 or 6.)  ----------- Prompt -----------  A one-shot sequence from a 90s-style cel-shaded-like SF military anime. BGM is low bass drone and heartbeat sounds, no dialogue, with ambient sounds.  # Constraints The camera basically never stays still, continuously moving forward or circling in. Fundamentally, it passes by the subject's side and enters the deep darkness behind them. However, in specified cuts, it performs a vertical rise from underground, entry into the pupil, and a bullet-time 360-degree circling in the climax. Do not use glow as flash or pulse. Overexposure of the entire frame is prohibited. Strictly adhere to the facial, hair, and equipment features from each character's reference images. If the image quality is rough, remake the images from scratch as references. 4K high definition, no noise, no blur, no flicker. Maintain consistency in characters' faces and clothing, no distortion, natural and smooth motion.  # Characters ## Character 1 ￼ Reference image  ## Character 2 ￼ Reference image  ## Character 3 ￼ Reference image  ## Character 4 ￼ Reference image  ## Character 5 ￼ Reference image  ## Character 6 ￼ Reference image  # Setting Ruined near-future city, night. Debris, mech hangar, tangled pipe corridors, rising steam, underground dark conduits, battlefield smoke. Lighting: Dull orange from distant flames, pale blue moonlight. Dark areas are vast, with light existing only locally. The 6 warriors each stand in separate locations, but within the same connected nighttime battlefield.  # Scene A one-shot sequence where the camera swims through the darkness in a single unbroken line, sequentially visiting each of the 6 warriors. The first half passes through debris, pipes, and steam-filled darkness to visit 3 of them, the 4th appears via a vertical rise from underground. From the 5th onward, it relays through the darkness of the pupil to the 6th's battlefield, and finally lavishly depicts the 6th's climax of unloading a barrage from a gun in bullet-time 360 degrees.  cut1: The camera advances low and slowly from the gap in dark debris. The silhouette of Character 1, crouched in the shadow of debris, emerges in the frontal darkness. Character 1 raises their face and glares toward the camera. The camera grazes the right side of Character 1's face and passes into the darkness behind them. Ambient sounds: Low rumble of collapsing debris, wind, faint crackle of distant flames.  cut2: The camera advances as if threading through the gaps in a mech's joint pipes. Beyond the pipe shadows, the silhouette of Character 2 standing in the hangar gloom emerges. Character 2 raises a pistol to cheek level and disengages the safety. The camera passes by the side of Character 2's raised gun arm, proceeding over the shoulder into the depths of the hangar darkness. Ambient sounds: Metallic mechanism clicks, safety's sharp click, low hum of the mech's drive.  cut3: The camera slowly advances through a mass of rising steam. From beyond the steam, the back of Character 3 standing in the smoke emerges. Character 3 slowly turns around while tucking hair behind their ear, fixing their gaze on the camera. @Image1

@Image1
. Blazing midsummer Japanese suburban street, heat haze rising from the asphalt. A high school girl in a summer sailor uniform trudges uphill, fanning herself, visibly wilting. Camera: slow push-in. Lighting: harsh overhead midday sun, strong contrast.

Camera: smooth tracking shot from the side, ending on her hero pose. Lighting: vivid golden sunlight, dynamic and energetic mood.
Dialogue (girl, confident smile to camera): 「夏に、負けない。」

Lighting: clean bright studio-style commercial lighting.
Narration (warm male CM voice, pronounced fei-bu-ru): 「フェイブル。」
Text: "夏に、負けない。フェイブル"

Style: photorealistic live-action Japanese TV commercial, cinematic quality, natural colors, bright summer palette (blue sky, white highlights, cool aqua product accents), 4K, sharp resolution.
Avoid: jitter, distortion, deformation, blur, flickering, ghosting, character drift, warped text on the can.

entries.text:
Claude Opus5.5 モーショングラフィックス
────────────────────
天才Opus5.5にどうやって作ったのか
説明させてみた（↓）
─────────
■ 全体の流れ
index.html（絵を描くプログラム）
      ↓ 1コマずつ描かせる
render .py（900コマを撮って動画ファイルにする）
      ↓
make_audio.py（音楽を計算で作る）
      ↓
合体して MP4

① すべてを「拍」で決めている
いちばん大事な考え方です。テンポを 128BPM にすると、32拍でちょうど15秒になります。「4拍目で MOVE が出る」「28拍目で爆発」のように、映像の出来事をすべて拍の番号で書いています。音楽も同じ拍の番号で鳴らしています。だから、映像と音がずれる余地がありません。手作業のタイミング合わせは一度もしていません

② 動きは「イージング（緩急）」の数式
たとえば文字が滑り込む動きは、「0→1 に進む割合」を数式で曲げて作っています。最初速く、最後ゆっくり止まる（expo）：MOVE の滑り込み
少し行き過ぎて戻る（back）：SHAPE の文字がポンと出る
跳ねて止まる（bounce）：RHYTHM の文字が落ちて弾む

グラフエディタの場面はこの「緩急の曲線」そのものを見せる演出です。モーションデザイナーが毎日さわる道具なので分かる人ほど「おっ」となるところです。

③ 図形の変形・3D・粒子もすべて計算
丸→四角→三角→星：図形のまわりを240点で表し、同じ点同士を少しずつ動かして変形させています
トンネルとワイヤーの立方体：遠くの物ほど小さく描く計算（遠近法）を自分で書いて、3Dっぽく見せています。

最後の CLAUDE：一度見えないところに文字を描き、文字の形の点を約5,000個拾っています。その位置へ粒子を集めています。

④ 仕上げの質感
モーションブラー：1コマを、ほんの少しずつ時間をずらして10回描き、平均しています。速い動きがなめらかにぶれて、映像らしくなります（5回だと残像が段々に見えたので10回にしました）
グリッチ：赤・緑・青の色を分けて左右にずらし、画面を横に切ってずらしています
フィルムの粒子・周辺の暗さ：薄いノイズを毎コマ違う位置に重ねています
四隅の表示（タイムコードなど）：「白黒反転」の重ね方で描いているので、どの背景色でも読めます

⑤ 書き出し
render. py が、画面を持たない Chrome を裏で起動します。「0コマ目を描いて → 画像を受け取る」を900回くり返し、そのまま ffmpeg（動画を作る道具）へ流して MP4 にしています。約6分かかりました。

⑥ 音楽も計算で作っている
楽器の音を、波の形の計算で作っています。
キック：低い音が一瞬で下がっていく波
ハット・スネア・「シュッ」という効果音：ザーッという雑音を削って形を整えたもの
和音：少しずつ音程をずらしたノコギリ波を7本重ねたもの

さらに、キックが鳴るたびに他の音を一瞬小さくして、クラブ音楽っぽいうねりを出しています。最後の決めの直前には、わざと0.1秒ほど完全な無音を入れて、爆発の落差を大きくしています。

entries.text:
Sometimes, just for fun, I test video models by deliberately keeping the prompt vague. I provide only a reference image and a general style prompt—absolutely no detailed instructions—just to see what the model comes up with.

And honestly, the results can sometimes look surprisingly decent. At the very least, they’re watchable, and the whole experiment is quite entertaining, although it does waste a fair amount of time and credits. 😂

That’s exactly how the 15-second video below was made. I’ve included the overall style prompt underneath, so if you’re interested, feel free to try it yourself and see how much the model can understand on its own.

Image : Midjourney
Video : Seedance 2.0
General style prompt :

Overall style: Hollywood blockbuster, ultra cinematic, Three Kingdoms epic realism, hyper-realistic cinematic style, IMAX-level epic battlefield, Ridley Scott–style war scale, Zack Snyder–style slow motion, authentic Three Kingdoms war atmosphere. Cold blue-toned sky, dust and smoke filling the air, cold metallic reflections, sparks flying, ochre-toned battlefield. Hans Zimmer percussion score, volumetric dust, dynamic camera, hyper realistic armor, dramatic sunset battlefield, IMAX scale, 8K, high contrast, motion debris, war atmosphere.
[Core aesthetics and environment] Top-tier Hollywood blockbuster action film quality, 60fps high frame rate. A Three Kingdoms battlefield, with soldiers from both sides locked in fierce combat. The camera switches between high-angle overhead shots and low-angle upward shots, emphasizing the epic battlefield imagery and the brutality of war, along with the intensity of a decisive life-or-death battle — like the climactic sequence of a genuine Three Kingdoms war film. Strong visual hook in the first 2 seconds, stable subject, fluid action, cinematic composition, realistic lighting and shadow, epic feel, strong emotion, highly detailed.
No subtitles, no dialogue, no narration throughout.
🚫 Negative prompts (avoid cheap-looking results): cartoon, anime, fake armor, floating weapon, bad anatomy, blurry face, cheap CGI, low detail horse, duplicated limbs, weak impact, soft action.

Character sheet:

Prompt:
Professional character reference sheet, three full-body panels side by side on one wide 16:9 canvas, same woman in all three, identical scale, identical lighting, feet aligned on the same ground line, each panel labeled small at the bottom: FRONT, SIDE, BACK.

IDENTITY (lock exactly from Image 4): woman in her early 20s, fair warm skin with a natural sun-kissed tone, soft oval face with high cheekbones and a gently defined jaw, striking light green-grey eyes, straight softly arched brown brows, straight refined nose, full natural pink lips, a light dusting of freckles across her nose and cheeks, small gold hoop earrings. Long wavy light-brown hair with sun-bleached golden-caramel strands, pulled back into a loose, messy low bun at the nape, with long face-framing curtain strands and soft wispy flyaways falling past her cheeks. No fringe or bangs. Calm, neutral, relaxed expression. Preserve her exact facial structure, eye colour, freckles and proportions, no beautification, no changes.

BODY: slim, natural feminine build, average height, relaxed natural posture, soft natural shoulders and arms.

WARDROBE (lock from Images 2 and 3): light sage-green paisley halter dress in a soft silky fabric, cream and olive paisley print, a deep V neckline, fabric ties gathered at the back of the neck, fitted softly at the waist, falling in a loose flowing A-line skirt to mid-calf with natural drape and movement. Open back, bare from the shoulder blades to the waist. Two thin delicate gold chains layered at the neck, each with a tiny gold cross pendant. Barefoot, natural bare feet. No belt, no rings, no bag, no sunglasses, no logos.

PANELS:
FRONT: facing camera straight on, arms relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet, looking directly into the lens, V neckline, necklaces and hoop earrings clearly readable.
SIDE: full 90-degree right profile, arms relaxed, clean silhouette showing the halter neckline, the drape of the skirt, the low bun and the line of her nose and lips.
BACK: facing directly away, arms relaxed, showing the halter tie at the back of the neck, the open back, the messy low bun with loose strands, and the flow of the skirt to the hem.

LIGHTING AND BACKGROUND: plain seamless warm light-grey studio backdrop, soft even diffused key light from the front with gentle fill, very soft shadow at the feet, no harsh contrast. Slightly warm natural colour, subtle fine film grain for realism.

REALISM: photorealistic, visible skin texture and pores, natural freckles on face and shoulders, individual flyaway hairs, real silky paisley fabric with natural folds and weight, fine gold chain detail, sharp focus across all three panels, 8K, true-to-life proportions, no stylisation.

Avoid: changing her face between panels, fringe or bangs, different outfits per panel, shoes, extra accessories, cartoon or 3D render look, dramatic or fashion poses, cropped feet or head, text other than the three small labels.

Light sage-green paisley halter dress with a deep neckline and silky drape, two thin gold chains with tiny gold cross pendants. Seen from the waist up, face visible near the top right, head tilted slightly down, eyes resting on her with a quiet warm half-smile, slightly softer in focus than her so she stays the hero.

No fringe or bangs. Calm, neutral, relaxed expression. Preserve her exact facial structure, eye colour, freckles and proportions, no beautification, no changes.

BODY: slim, natural feminine build, average height, relaxed natural posture, soft natural shoulders and arms.

WARDROBE (lock from Images 2 and 3): light sage-green paisley halter dress in a soft silky fabric, cream and olive paisley print, a deep V neckline, fabric ties gathered at the back of the neck, fitted softly at the waist, falling in a loose flowing A-line skirt to mid-calf with natural drape and movement. No belt, no rings, no bag, no sunglasses, no logos.

FRONT: facing camera straight on, arms relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet, looking directly into the lens, V neckline, necklaces and hoop earrings clearly readable.
SIDE: full 90-degree right profile, arms relaxed, clean silhouette showing the halter neckline, the drape of the skirt, the low bun and the line of her nose and lips.
BACK: facing directly away, arms relaxed, showing the halter tie at the back of the neck, the open back, the messy low bun with loose strands, and the flow of the skirt to the hem.

CINEMATIC FANTASY | THE LAST SKY DRAGON
Format: 16:9 | Duration: 25 seconds | 4K | Photorealistic CGI
Full Video Generation Prompt
Scene & Atmosphere
Create an extraordinary cinematic fantasy short set on the highest mountain in an ancient kingdom, thousands of feet above an endless sea of clouds.
At the summit stands a magnificent ruined stone sanctuary surrounded by gigantic waterfalls, floating mountain islands, ancient carved dragon statues, and enormous broken towers. A vast celestial storm covers the horizon. Brilliant lightning illuminates the clouds while powerful winds sweep through the sanctuary.
Far beyond the mountains, something unimaginably enormous moves inside the storm.
The story must combine the tenderness of a baby dragon with the breathtaking scale of a legendary ancient dragon. The entire sequence should feel like a spectacular live-action fantasy movie, with photorealistic CGI, convincing creature movement, enormous environmental scale, natural cinematic lighting, and strong emotional storytelling.
Main Characters
The Young Woman: A beautiful young woman with long, wavy dark brown hair, soft hazel eyes, and natural expressive facial features. She wears a flowing deep-blue medieval cloak over a cream-colored dress, weathered leather boots, and a delicate silver pendant. Her hair and clothing react naturally to the powerful mountain winds. Her personality is gentle, compassionate, and courageous.
The Baby Dragon: An adorable, cat-sized baby dragon with pearly white scales, subtle rose-gold patterns, enormous luminous amber eyes, two tiny curved golden horns, delicate pointed ears, four small legs, and a long slender tail. Its two translucent pale-pink wings have intricate golden veins and physically coherent folding joints. Its movements are playful, slightly clumsy, and emotionally expressive. Small golden sparks occasionally escape its nostrils.
The Ancient Mother Dragon: An unimaginably colossal, majestic dragon approximately 400 meters long, with an immense wingspan stretching across the sky. Its body is covered in magnificent pearly ivory scales with intricate gold patterns that match the baby dragon. It possesses four powerful legs, two gigantic anatomically consistent wings, enormous backward-curving golden horns, a long armored neck, and a massive serpentine tail. Its eyes glow with ancient golden light. Despite its overwhelming size, its behavior is protective, gentle, and intelligent. Every movement conveys tremendous weight and controlled power.
Scene 1 | 0–6 Seconds: The Forgotten Sanctuary
Begin with an astonishing aerial wide shot of an ancient mountain sanctuary rising above a boundless ocean of storm clouds. In the first second, a flash of lightning reveals the gigantic shadow of a dragon's wing stretching across the distant sky before disappearing into darkness.
The camera smoothly descends toward a ruined stone balcony, where the young woman discovers a tiny baby dragon shivering beneath a broken stone statue.
The baby dragon tries to spread its delicate wings, but the powerful wind forces it to crouch. The woman gently kneels and shelters it with her cloak.
Capture an intimate close-up as the baby looks up at her with enormous amber eyes. She carefully strokes its tiny golden horns. The dragon makes a soft, affectionate chirping sound and presses its forehead against her hand.
Scene 2 | 6–12 Seconds: The Call of the Dragon
The woman carefully lifts the baby dragon onto an ancient stone pedestal overlooking the cloud ocean.
The little creature looks toward the dark horizon and spreads its translucent wings. Its throat begins glowing with a beautiful golden light.
It opens its mouth and releases a tiny, brilliant stream of golden dragonfire into the sky. The flame rises several meters before dissolving into glowing sparks.
Suddenly, an enormous, deeply resonant dragon roar answers from somewhere beneath the clouds.
The woman freezes in astonishment.
The sanctuary begins trembling. Fine dust falls from the ancient pillars, loose stones vibrate, and thousands of golden lights become visible through the distant cloud formations.
The baby dragon excitedly flaps its wings and looks toward the approaching sound.
Scene 3 | 12–19 Seconds: The Dragon That Covers the Sky
Cut to a spectacular ultra-wide cinematic shot looking outward from behind the woman and the baby dragon.
Far beyond the sanctuary, the massive cloud ocean begins to swell upward. Brilliant golden light spreads through the storm.
Then, the immense horned head of the Ancient Mother Dragon slowly emerges from the clouds.
Its colossal ivory-scaled neck rises into view, followed by a gigantic armored body. The enormous dragon unfurls its magnificent golden-veined wings, revealing a wingspan so vast that it stretches across the mountain horizon.
Powerful air currents carry immense clouds around its wings as it ascends. The dragon's enormous shadow passes over floating mountains, waterfalls, and the ancient sanctuary.
The camera holds a wide, stable perspective, showing the tiny woman and baby dragon in the foreground while the colossal mother rises in the distance.
The ancient dragon releases a deep, magnificent roar that echoes across the entire kingdom.
Golden sunlight breaks through openings in the storm clouds, illuminating the dragon's shimmering scales.
The woman watches in complete disbelief as the magnificent creature slowly turns its enormous golden eyes toward the tiny baby.
Scene 4 | 19–25 Seconds: The Reunion of the Sky Dragons
Capture a beautiful medium shot as the woman gently raises her arm and allows the baby dragon to climb onto her hand.
The baby spreads its tiny wings, flaps vigorously, and takes flight toward its enormous mother.
The giant dragon glides closer to the mountain sanctuary on the powerful rising air currents, carefully lowering its magnificent horned head to the level of the balcony.
The tiny baby reaches its mother's massive snout and affectionately touches its forehead against her golden scales.
The mother closes one gigantic eye in a tender expression of recognition. A warm golden glow pulses across the intricate patterns on both dragons.
The woman smiles emotionally, watching the reunion from the balcony.
For the final breathtaking shot, the camera pulls back into a majestic ultra-wide aerial perspective. The Ancient Mother Dragon glides above the golden clouds with the tiny baby flying safely beside her head.
Her enormous wings fill the sky, dwarfing entire mountains, waterfalls, and ancient towers as they soar toward the radiant sun beyond the clouds.
End on a spectacular, emotionally uplifting cinematic composition.
Cinematic Style & Visual Effects
Ultra-photorealistic Hollywood fantasy CGI, visually stunning creature animation, intricately detailed dragon scales, realistic skin textures, physically convincing wing membranes, anatomically consistent dragon bodies, natural eye movements, authentic human expressions, realistic cloth and hair physics, massive volumetric storm clouds, cinematic atmospheric perspective, breathtaking aerial environments, detailed mountain geology, natural cloud displacement, subtle film grain, and dramatic wide-angle compositions.
Maintain exact visual consistency of both dragons. The baby and mother must share recognizable ivory scales, golden markings, horn structure, and amber eyes.
Use slow, powerful wing movements for the colossal dragon to emphasize its immense size, with enormous mountain updrafts supporting its flight. Keep the baby's wingbeats quick and appropriately scaled. Preserve continuous geographical relationships between the sanctuary, balcony, floating mountains, and arriving mother dragon.
Begin with majestic cold-blue storm lighting, then gradually reveal beautiful golden sunlight as the mother dragon emerges.
Sound Design & Music
Begin with howling mountain winds, distant thunder, and the gentle sound of the baby's tiny footsteps against stone.
Introduce delicate magical chimes as its throat begins glowing. Its first attempt at breathing fire produces a small, innocent squeak followed by a soft magical flame.
When the mother answers, create a tremendously deep, resonant dragon roar echoing across the mountains. Add powerful atmospheric rumbles, wind displacement from the giant wings, and cinematic low-frequency bass.
Build the orchestral soundtrack with majestic brass, sweeping strings, emotional piano, and powerful cinematic percussion during the mother dragon's emergence.
Transition to beautiful, warm orchestral music during the reunion, ending with an uplifting musical crescendo.
Negative Prompt
No text, no subtitles, no watermark, no cartoon style, no plastic CGI, no extra wings, no additional limbs, no duplicated dragons, no malformed wing joints, no inconsistent scales, no changing horn structures, no unrealistic rapid movements from the giant dragon, no unnatural flying poses, no teleportation, no chaotic camera movements, no distorted faces, no inconsistent spatial geography, no sudden environment changes, no aggressive behavior toward the woman, no horror aesthetics, no excessive fire, no violent destruction, no flickering lighting, and no abrupt scene transitions.
Key cinematic detail: The giant dragon should not suddenly appear at full size. Its head emerges first, then its neck and body, and finally the wings unfold across the horizon. This progressive reveal makes the creature feel truly colossal and gives the 12–19 second sequence its strongest visual impact.
